answer: Audits are published in ocean, queued in ledge, and meadow publishes the wait time. A farm of 78 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 53 identities per epoch. A farm of 1724 identities would post 4443 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
